title.narrative: Carbon Fund of the Forest Carbon Partnership Facility

description.narrative:
"The FCPF concept and development objectives were discussed and approved by the World Bank Board of Directors on September 25, 2007.
This Carbon Fund will focus on piloting emission reduction payments in a few REDD Participant Countries. About five interested countries might be selected to test and evaluate pilot incentive programs for REDD. These programs will compensate the seller country, or its designated entities, for emission reductions from avoided deforestation. Countries that are interested and selected for the pilots would receive payments for reducing emissions below the reference scenario after the reductions are verified. The structure of these incentive payments will build on options for REDD that are currently being discussed within the UNFCCC process, with payments used to help address the causes of deforestation and degradation. Payments will only be made to countries that achieve measurable and independently verified emission reductions.
In combination with the FCPF Readiness Fund, the Facility will aim to develop and test a new instrument and incentive framework fortackling deforestation and forest degradation."
